title: anthyllis vulneraria subsp. variegata
intro: Anthyllis vulneraria subsp. variegata, commonly known as Knapweed or Wild Clover, is a plant species belonging to the legume family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of wounds, inflammation, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Anthyllis vulneraria subsp. variegata include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its wound-healing and immune-boosting effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and phenolic acids, which may be responsible for its medicinal properties.
